verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single docs line saying Appwrite's managed database APIs come "with permissions" (appwrite-docs-23). That points to a first-party access-control layer, but nothing shows how it restricts rows or documents per user, and nothing describes row-level or rule-based policies. JWT delegation and firewall rules are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documentation of per-user or per-row permission rules, details of the policy model (roles, teams, document-level permissions), examples of enforcement, independent or hands-on corroboration.
